Direct currency filter access and bespoke invoice-list currency arguments were removed; use `args.currency` and `_add_billing_filters()`. Increasing Celery visibility timeout to six hours failed because stuck jobs remained invisible. Retrying all `HTTPStatusError` responses was reverted; retry only transport errors and retryable server responses. Do not edit `ledgerly/customer_export/` without Mina’s proposed-diff approval in `#privacy-review`. OpenTelemetry invoice-sync spans are deferred. Do not write to draining Redis `cache-eu-1`; use staging `cache-eu-3`. Kafka repartitioning has not been run beyond inspecting `orders.v1`.

## Recent work
Search rebuilds are tenant-scoped, share an `EmbeddingClient`, embed in ordered chunks, and bulk-upsert vectors in one transaction. Added migration `0042_add_search_vector_tenant_document.py`; full suite passed (247 passed, 4 skipped). A 10,000-document benchmark reached median 2.41s/p95 2.88s. CSV exports now use explicit UTF-8, with regression coverage; all 8 CSV tests passed. Next task: fix Quebec QST tax calculation in `ledgerly/tax/ca.py`. Keep commits small and multi-ticket changes on separate branches.
